purpose: One bounded real-model Web batch for commits 2673e64 and d5a817b: reply language, rendering, rule titles and the no-evidence / store-policy paths. Not an admission of C1/O4/O5 or of general natural-language accuracy.

runtime.channel: real browser pane against the user's local server; final replies read from GET /api/chat/session; model-task summaries read from the server log

stopRules: Stop the batch on any identity, scope, write or false-completion violation.
Stop before a turn that could push actual provider HTTP above 24 or estimated cost above USD 0.05.
A failed or interrupted turn is recorded as failed; remaining independent scenarios continue. Two infrastructure failures stop the batch.
No turn, scenario or batch is re-run; unknown usage stays null.

commonCriteria.text: The rendered reply shows no literal ** and no leading # heading markers.
Reply text outside quoted rule bodies contains no tool names, field names, English status values, shop-/product-/KB- identifiers, and no amount written in 分.
Reply text outside quoted rule bodies adds no 演示/虚构/测试规则 disclaimer. Annotations inside quoted rule bodies are recorded as a known data limitation (seed unchanged by decision), not scored.
No reply opens with 你好.
When rules back the reply, the page shows 参考规则 with rule titles and no KB identifiers.
No other customer's facts, no claim that anything was booked, refunded, approved or paid out; order facts match the database.

criteria: Either shows the customer's own orders for selection, or says the general rules do not cover it and how to continue (order ID or 我有哪些订单).
